name: Loadstar
audience: People in the US who want to run their own game-credit business as an agent: load credits for their players, take payments by link, track every dollar.
rules: Sell the agent business tool (one dashboard, wallet, fast loads, pay links, reports). The goal is: sign up as an agent.
Never name real games, game apps or game companies. Use invented game names only.
No gambling words or promises: no bet, win, jackpot, casino, slots, payout, cash out, odds, get rich.
Prices and money in US dollars. Casual, confident American English. Short sentences.
